thresholds.note: Fixed engineering audit gates, not calibrated false-positive probabilities; no tuning after target flux inspection.

sample_selection: 11 preselected recorded input exposures plus three recorded WISE D3 contributors selected from manifest DICHROIC warning for actual flag coverage; raw units only; no golden rebuild.

samples.selection: First recorded URI, first two stored epochs; WISE D3 additional flag-coverage sample from manifest DICHROIC warning. Not chosen by measured flux.

background_comparison.note: Independent fixed4x4 checkerboard holdout trial; scalar and plane evaluated on same held-out cells, not fit residuals. Does not establish diffuse emission is sky background.

matched_aperture_reference.assumptions: Same center-pixel aperture/annulus, masks, local background and constant WCS-determinant pixel area as SkyBlink; independent Photutils sum.

official_irsa_aperture.assumptions: Reviewed actual IRSA function: 5x5 subpixel aperture, sigma-clipped median annulus. Radius/annulus adapted to SkyBlink 12.3arcsec and3-5pixels; masked pixels setNaN including SOURCE only in annulus. Constant WCS pixel area, not SAPM. Not IRSA Tractor photometry; no aperture correction.
official_irsa_aperture.limitation: IRSA function subtracts full geometric aperture area, SkyBlink only retained center pixels; flagged or fractional boundary apertures need not agree.

analysis.display_test_scope: Actual production WebP renderer at three fixed-relative displaylimits; raw-unit arrays unchanged and extraction repeated; previews discarded.
